route_title: Local thickness refinement of 8-layer ZnSe/ZnS stack with ±1.5 nm bounded optimizer
compilation_rationale: Compiles an 8-layer Air|ZnSe|ZnS alternating stack on a Ge substrate. Explicit ±1.5 nm thickness bounds bracket initialization. Two mean-transmittance objectives enforce high transmission in 8000–11000 nm and low transmission in 3000–5000 nm at normal incidence. Fixed null targets to 0.0 to resolve type error.
